env GOPROXY=off

cd fix

# The linter rejects a group child that waits on a plain channel receive
# in a helper function: correctness::unbounded_channel_op is deny, so the
# build fails before the monitor can run. There is no monitor-only gap
# for this shape. The monitor, --fix, and rerun steps cannot run on this
# fixture; assert the lint diagnostic instead.
! logos lint ./...
stderr '^stalled[/\\]main\.lgo:16:2: \[correctness::unbounded_channel_op\] receive from ch may block forever'

-- fix/go.mod --
module example.com/concfix

go 1.27
-- fix/stalled/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func fail() error {
	return errors.New("first job failed")
}

func slow(ctx context.Context) error {
	ch := time.After(1500 * time.Millisecond)
	<-ch
	return nil
}

func jobs(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go fail()
		go slow(ctx)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("jobs done:", jobs(context.Background()))
}
-- fix/stalled/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestJobs(t *testing.T) {
	if err := jobs(t.Context()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("the first job did not fail the group")
	}
}
